# Vendored Zirbel packages

The checked-in archives are built from [matapao/zirbel](https://github.com/matapao/zirbel):

| Archive                        | Package                     | License |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------------- | ------- |
| `zirbel-core-2.0.0.tgz`        | `@zirbel/core` 2.0.0        | MIT     |
| `zirbel-statistics-2.0.0.tgz`  | `@zirbel/statistics` 2.0.0  | MIT     |
| `zirbel-engineering-1.0.0.tgz` | `@zirbel/engineering` 1.0.0 | MIT     |

Copyright (c) 2026 The zirbel authors. The full permission notice is in
[zirbel-LICENSE.txt](zirbel-LICENSE.txt). Retain it alongside these archives when redistributing source.
The core and statistics archives also contain their own `package/LICENSE`; the engineering archive
omits that file, so the accompanying notice supplies its upstream license without changing the
integrity-pinned package. Third-party npm dependencies keep their respective package licenses.
